Future Traveler icon concepts

Sticker and paper-cut icons for HAX's official mascot, the Future Traveler, in DDD colors. Concepts only, not in use.

Hover or tab to an icon: his lightbulb glows once, rays spring out, then it stays lit. With reduced motion on, it just lights up. Small previews show 40 and 20 px.

Sticker

Die-cut sticker. The white border keeps it readable on any surface.
